newsitem.title: USA: John H. Myers named president of GE Investments.
newsitem.headline: John H. Myers named president of GE Investments.

text.p: John H. Myers, 51, has been named President of GE Investments, the company said Wednesday. He succeeds Dale F. Frey, who is retiring after 40 years with General Electric.
"John Myers is a seasoned veteran of GE's financial community and of GE Investments," the company said.

GE Investments, which manages $56 billion in assets, is made up of two subsidiaries of the General Electric Co -- General Electric Investment Corp (GEIC), which manages GE's pension trust and employee savings program; and GE Investment Management Incorporated (GEIM), which has been managing money for institutional clients since 1988.
